data_description.live_source: Default for NVR channels. If the preferred source fails, the bridge tries the other source and returns when it recovers. Per-camera overrides take precedence. Recorded playback stays on the NVR.
data_description.live_preconnect: Uses the preferred video profile above and the bridge-selected camera/NVR source. Reduces RTSP connection setup only; keyframes and player buffering can still delay video. Continuous mode receives video even without viewers. Home Assistant's separate Preload stream option also keeps its native playback pipeline ready.
